body:
## Pull request overview

This PR expands the Storybook CRM demo with richer entities and detail views while fixing schema issues that previously caused mostly empty renders. It aligns the grid and card schemas with the current ObjectUI spec and wires in realistic mock data so all CRM pages show meaningful content.

**Changes:**
- Added Accounts, Contact Detail, and Opportunity Detail schemas with corresponding mock data and wired them into the CRM Story sidebar and renderer switch.
- Updated Contacts and Opportunities grids to use `staticData` and top-level `columns`, and enhanced the Opportunities grid with contact and close date columns.
- Introduced an “Examples” sidebar section and updated icons (Accounts, Opportunities, and detail examples) to better showcase complex views.

The sidebar entry for the opportunity detail view uses mixed terminology (tooltip says "Opportunity Detail View" while the visible label is "Deal Detail"), whereas the page schema and route key consistently use "Opportunity". For clarity and consistency in the CRM example, consider standardizing this entry to a single term (e.g., "Opportunity Detail") so that tooltip, label, and page title all match. ```suggestion tooltip="Opportunity Detail" > Opportunity Detail ```
